s20.title: Data Passport
s20.speak: Here is where every number in this app comes from.
s20.intro: Every number has a source. Here they are.

rain.label: Rain
rain.method: Monthly rain, typical and dry/wet years (20th to 80th percentile).

temp.label: Heat
temp.method: Monthly average temperature, used for heat risk.

soil.label: Soil
soil.method: Sand, clay and acidity at your spot, written in plain words.

veg.label: Plants from space
veg.method: Plant greenness, used to check our risk map against real years.

window.label: Planting window
window.method: First months when the usual rain covers what crops need. Past years only, not a forecast.

limits: It is not a weather forecast. It shows what is usual from past years.
Data is a map of a large square, not your exact field.
It does not promise any harvest or money.
Always ask a local agronomist before you decide.
s20.toProof: Did it work in the past?

s21.title: Proof
s21.speak: We checked our risk map against real past droughts and floods.
s21.intro: We compared our risk map with real bad years. We show the misses too.
s21.ndviBody: When our risk goes up, plant greenness (NDVI) should go down.
s21.review: An agronomist has not yet checked these results.
s21.ndviNone: Not computed yet. We will show it once we have checked it.

s22.title: Settings
s22.speak: Change language, text size and voice here.
s22.offlineBody: Save the app and advice on this phone.
s22.clearBody: Removes saved farms, plans and settings from this phone.

s23.title: About
s23.speak: Who we are, and what we do with your data. Nothing about you is kept.
s23.pitch: A map-first guide that helps farmers choose what to plant next, using NASA satellite data.
notCollected: No account, no name, no phone number.
No exact location. Places are rounded.
Saved farms stay on your phone only.
collected: Anonymous counts of visits, plans and shares.
Thumbs up or down, without any name.
licenceList: NASA data (GIBS, POWER, MODIS): open data, credit NASA.
CHIRPS rainfall: open data, credit UCSB Climate Hazards Center.
